class.name: ScenarioScriptServer
class.description: Runs the scripts of a scenario (the original's [code]lua <file>[/code]). A context is one scenario's script environment: the code loaded into it and everything its scripts made - their events, timers and subscriptions - which [method context_free] takes along. The scripts reach the simulation only through the servers' public APIs. A script's function never runs inside the server that reported something: timers, events and subscriptions run as [ScenarioEventServer] events, on the simulation clock, and stop while the simulation is paused. The code of a context runs in units - a file, or code applied under a name ([method context_apply_source]); applying a unit again first frees what its previous run made. In a build without a runtime every script is refused with an error.

method.name: context_apply_source
method.description: Frees what [param unit] made before, then runs [param source] as that unit. Returns [code]false[/code] when it failed; the error is logged and reported by [signal script_error].

method.name: context_attach_cabin_implementation
method.description: Gives the context's scripts their way to the cabs ([code]maszyna.cabin[/code]).

method.name: context_check_source
method.description: Compiles [param source] without running it. Returns the error, empty when there is none; its positions are named after [param unit].

method.name: context_create
method.description: Creates a context whose scripts load their files and modules from [param base_dir] and nowhere else.

method.name: context_free
method.description: Frees the context with everything its scripts made.

method.name: context_run_file
method.description: Runs a file of the context's base directory as the unit named after it. Returns [code]false[/code] when it failed.

signal.name: script_error
signal.description: A script of the context failed; [param message] says where and why. The error is in the game log as well.
